verdict.rationale: Sift is API-first: events, decisions, and scores all flow through REST APIs and SDKs, and Workflows automate risk decisions in real time. That makes headless, programmatic operation its core mode of use (sift-docs-1, sift-docs-2, sift-docs-3, sift-docs-12). Missing for 10: no CLI or CI-pipeline-specific tooling or guidance, and no independent hands-on corroboration of automation-driven usage.
